title: Enactment of rules.
bodyText: The department shall adopt the necessary rules not later than one and one-half years after July 1, 2007.
bodyHtml: §179D-9  Enactment of rules.  The department shall adopt the necessary rules not later than one and one-half years after July 1, 2007. [L 1987, c 199, pt of §1; am L 2007, c 262, §10]
